name: localpass-firefox
description: LocalPass Firefox Extension – local-first password management

scripts.build: parcel build manifest.json && npm run postbuild:firefox
scripts.postbuild:firefox: jq 'del(.background.service_worker)' dist/manifest.json > dist/manifest.json.tmp && mv dist/manifest.json.tmp dist/manifest.json
scripts.package: npm run build && npx web-ext build --source-dir=dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.lint: npm run build && npx web-ext lint --source-dir=dist
